segments.arabic:
١٠٨٠٠- أسماء بنت سعيد
بن زيد بن عمرو بن نفيل القرشية العدوية.
لها ولأبيها صحبة.
وأخرج حديثها الدار الدّارقطنيّ في العلل، من رواية حفص بن غياث، عن أبي حرملة، عن أبي، فقال: عن رباح بن عبد الرحمن، حدثتني جدتي أنها سمعت رسول اللَّه ﷺ يقول: «لا صلاة لمن لا وضوء له ...» الحديث.
وأخرجه البيهقيّ، وقال: جدته أسماء بنت سعيد بن زيد.
segments.english:
10800 — Asma bint Sa'id

ibn Zayd ibn Amr ibn Nufayl, the Qurashi woman of the Adi clan.

She and her father were Companions.

al-Daraqutni transmitted her hadith in al-'Ilal, through Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from Abu Harmala, from Abu Thifal, from Ribah ibn Abd al-Rahman, who said: “My grandmother related to me that she heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) say: ‘There is no prayer for one who has no ablution ...’” —to the end of the hadith.

[Editorial note: The canonical text reads al-dar al-Daraqutni, with al-dar duplicated, and later reads “from Abi, and he said: from Ribah.” The chain has been emended transparently to “from Abu Thifal, from Ribah” on the evidence of al-Daraqutni's parallel transmission in al-'Ilal.]

al-Bayhaqi also transmitted it and said: “His grandmother was Asma bint Sa'id ibn Zayd.”
